title: Vikram and Betal: The Caring Daughter
moral: Respect and care for your parents.

scenes.summary: Betal tells a story about a caring daughter.
scenes.text: Betal told Vikram about a daughter who cared for her father.
scenes.image_prompt: vikram carrying betal in forest cartoon style

scenes.text: The old man became weak and could not work.
scenes.image_prompt: old man sitting weak while daughter helps cartoon

scenes.text: The daughter worked daily to take care of her father.
scenes.image_prompt: daughter working and caring for father cartoon

scenes.text: People questioned why she worked so hard.
scenes.image_prompt: people talking while daughter listens calmly cartoon

scenes.text: The king praised and rewarded her. Vikram answered wisely, and Betal flew away.
scenes.image_prompt: king rewarding daughter while smiling cartoon

story: A daughter cared for her weak father with love and dedication. The king rewarded her. Vikram said love and duty make a person special.
